text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is a 1,200-meter sprint… Considering my current condition, this should be my best chance at taking home the gold.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But before that, there's one last thing I want to check with you. Trainer, will this be my last race in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Prix Jacques Le Marois is held in mid-August. Technically, we could also have her run in the Yasuda Kinen in the first half of June…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I want her to have ample time to prepare before she starts running abroad. At the moment, I plan on having her head out directly from here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Got it. Well, since I'm going to be leaving my domestic fans behind for a while…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'd better give them a show to remember.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So, who's the rival who's going to be sending me off today?
You'll be up against me today! Hi-yah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus, a hero-idolizing Umamusume, suddenly drops down from above us.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get first place and become a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Pearl! I won't hand over the world to the likes of you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I'm taking it anyway—that's what I'm running for.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I'm not claiming it as my own to make it suffer. I just want to make the world a happier place.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Make the world… a happier place?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then does that mean you wanna become this world's hero, too?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A hero, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl thinks for a moment…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Not quite. I'm not a hero. If you want to know what I am…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You'll just have to run against me. ♪ Good luck today.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl plays along with Biko Pegasus's hero charade. But unlike in cartoons, there's no way to tell who the winner of today's battle will be.
